description: This file contains C source code implementing process and CPU/memory usage utilities for a device, including functions to retrieve process info, CPU and memory utilization, and process status, with conditional support for different platforms.

methods.name: getProcUsage
methods.description: Retrieves CPU and memory usage for a specified process by name, updating search results.

methods.name: getProcPidStat
methods.description: Retrieves detailed process status information from /proc/<pid>/stat.

methods.name: getProcInfo
methods.description: Aggregates process memory and CPU info into a procMemCpuInfo structure.

methods.name: getMemInfo
methods.description: Calculates total resident memory for a process or set of processes.

methods.name: getCPUInfo
methods.description: Calculates total CPU usage for a set of processes, platform-dependent.

methods.name: getTotalCpuTimes
methods.description: Reads total CPU times from /proc/stat for Linux platforms.

methods.name: getProcessCpuUtilization
methods.description: Calculates CPU utilization percentage for a process over a short interval.
